findings.evidence: 28 rows affected (all participants with PHQ-9 totals from 15 to 19, e.g., R0029, R0131, R0155).
findings.description: The pipeline uses incorrect severity cutoffs for the PHQ-9 band calculation, incorrectly grouping scores of 15 to 19 as 'severe' (omitting the 'moderately severe' category entirely and setting the severe cutpoint at 15 instead of 20).
